tools.name: ping
tools.description:
Checks that this MCP server is reachable and reports its version.

Use this only to diagnose connection problems. It returns no course data.

tools.name: seminars_search
tools.description:
Finds seminars in the IT-Schulungen.com catalogue.

Use this first when a topic is known but the seminar identifier is not.
The search is semantic and covers the whole seminar text, so describe the
goal in the customer's own words -- "wie sichere ich unsere
Container-Umgebung ab" finds Docker and Ku

tools.name: seminar_get
tools.description:
Returns one seminar with its description, agenda and prerequisites.

The texts are markdown. Prices come along in full, one per delivery form
with what is included and what costs extra -- the only place that says
so; `seminars_search` carries the amounts alone.

`url` is the seminar's page on IT-Sch

tools.name: seminar_dates
tools.description:
Lists the scheduled dates of a seminar, soonest first.

Past dates are never returned. Without `from` the window starts today.
`from` and `to` are calendar days in German time, and both are included.
An empty result means nothing is currently scheduled -- it does not mean
the seminar does not exist.

tools.name: seminar_topics
tools.description:
Searches the topic vocabulary seminars are tagged with.

Use this to turn a customer's wording into a filter value for
`seminars_search`, and to check whether a product or technology is
covered at all. Aliases are searched too, so "K8s" finds "Kubernetes" and
"AKS" finds "Azure Kubernetes Services".

tools.name: seminar_locations
tools.description:
Lists the places seminars are held at.

The catalogue runs in a fixed set of cities, plus a virtual classroom for
online delivery. Use this to answer "where do you teach this?" and to
check a place before passing it to `seminar_dates` -- a city that is not

tools.name: seminar_difficulties
tools.description:
Lists the difficulty levels a seminar can be filtered by.

Call this before passing `difficulty` to `seminars_search`; the filter
takes an identifier, not a label.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seminars_search, seminar_get, seminar_dates · Private data: seminars_search · Public sink: seminars_search, seminar_get · Destructive: seminars_search, seminar_dates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seminars_search, seminar_get, seminar_dates · Private data: seminars_search · Public sink: seminars_search, seminar_get · Destructive: seminars_search, seminar_dates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
